_README.purpose: Ready-to-use JSON-LD for yelhaa.info. Replace the existing objects in components/seo/json-ld.tsx.
_README.important: All URLs below assume NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://yelhaa.info is set in Vercel Production. In code, keep building them with absoluteUrl() rather than hardcoding the domain — the existing pattern is correct.

not_included_and_why.FAQPage: Google retired FAQ rich results for ALL sites on 2026-05-07. No SERP feature exists, and any AI-citation benefit is unconfirmed. The codebase already documents this decision in components/seo/json-ld.tsx — it is correct. Do not add.
not_included_and_why.QAPage: Reserved for genuine user Q&A pages where visitors submit answers. The /faq/[slug] pages are publisher-authored single answers with no user submissions, so QAPage would misdescribe them.
not_included_and_why.HowTo: Rich results removed September 2023. Never recommend.
not_included_and_why.AggregateRating: Omitted deliberately. Do not add until real, verifiable ratings are displayed on the page — marking up invisible ratings is a structured-data violation and risks a manual action.
not_included_and_why.Product: Not applicable. SoftwareApplication is the correct type for a SaaS product.
